items.title: Oregon utility’s biogas projects with WM, Tyson stall
items.summary: NW Natural invested millions into a partnership with Tyson Foods for two digesters, one of which has shut down, per a report. WM has also confirmed a proposed landfill project with the utility is not moving forward.

items.title: 1 Cash-Producing Stock on Our Watchlist and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: While strong cash flow is a key indicator of stability, it doesn’t always translate to superior returns. Some cash-heavy businesses struggle with inefficient spending, slowing demand, or weak competitive positioning.

items.title: Bear of the Day: Tyson Foods (TSN)
items.summary: TSN shares are down roughly 13% over the last three months, facing pressure following its latest set of results and falling further following updated guidance that came in early September.

items.title: Can Tyson Foods Keep Paying Its Dividend While Beef Bleeds Money?
items.summary: Beef is bleeding hundreds of millions in losses while Tyson's stock slides, yet the company keeps writing dividend checks without flinching. Whether that confidence is earned or reckless depends on what you look at first.

items.title: 3 Defensive US Stocks Retail Investors May Want As Rates Stay Higher
items.summary: The Fed just pushed rates to 3.75%–4.00% and signaled they could stay higher for longer, which puts every stock’s price tag under a harsher spotlight. When borrowing costs rise and easy money fades, investors often rush to what looks sturdier, only to realize some “safe” picks are not as resilient as hoped.
